description: Computing the modulus |z| and argument arg(z) of complex numbers given in algebraic form, including multiple-choice questions and finding z from modulus/argument constraint equations.

source.description: Cambodian BAC II grade-12 math textbook, Chapter 2 (complex numbers, trigonometric form / powers / roots) — exercises only
source.extracted_by: manual OCR/transcription from scanned textbook (Claude Code), 2026-08-25

exercises.prompt_latex: \text{Given } z = -8 + 6i \text{, the modulus of } z \text{ is:} \quad \text{(ក) } |z|=14 \quad \text{(ខ) } |z|=2 \quad \text{(គ) } |z|=5 \quad \text{(ង) } |z|=10 \quad \text{(ច) other answer}

\text{Given } z = 2x + i(1-x^2),\ x \in \mathbb{R} \text{. The modulus of } z \text{ is:} \quad \text{(ក) } |z|=\sqrt{1+x^2} \quad \text{(ខ) } |z|=(1+x^2)^2 \quad \text{(គ) } |z|=1+x^2 \quad \text{(ង) } |z|=1+|x| \quad \text{(ច) other answer}

\text{Given } z = -2\sqrt{3} - 2i \text{. The modulus of } z \text{ is:} \quad \text{(ក) } |z|=4 \quad \text{(ខ) } |z|=8 \quad \text{(គ) } |z|=16 \quad \text{(ង) } |z|=\sqrt{14} \quad \text{(ច) other answer}

\text{Given } z = 4\sqrt{2}(1+i) \text{. One argument of } z \text{ is:} \quad \text{(ក) } \frac{\pi}{8} \quad \text{(ខ) } \frac{\pi}{4} \quad \text{(គ) } \frac{\pi}{6} \quad \text{(ង) } \frac{\pi}{6} \quad \text{(ច) other answer}
exercises.technique: arg(z) from a+ib form, multiple choice
